body.name: Vhat
body.def: With \(\widehat\phi_i=\sum_{k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K}\omega_k\{\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}-\widehat\theta_k\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}/\widehat\pi_{g,1}\}-\widehat\alpha^{-\ell}(X_i)'\widehat S_i^{-\ell}\) for \(i\in I_\ell\), \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}=n^{-1}\sum_i(\widehat\phi_i-\overline{\widehat\phi})^2\).
